description: Before you call a change done: the changed files (against git HEAD, another ref with `base`, or a `files` list), what each change touches in a three.js scene (the whole picture: colour space, tone mapping, pixel ratio, shadows, environment; lights, camera, materials, shaders, assets, the loop, disposal, input, post-processing, the three version, the build), the files that run the changed code through the import graph, the pages that end up running it, the kept scenarios and baselines that cover those pages, and the numbered checks that prove the change. `run: true` also reviews the changed files and runs the affected scenarios. Read-only.

base.description: git ref to compare with (default HEAD: the uncommitted work, new files included)

detail.description: brief (capped, short) or full (everything); default brief

files.description: changed files (relative to the project) instead of git

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

run.description: also review the changed files and run the affected scenarios

name: three_impact
title: What this change touches, and how to prove it
